notes

Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive. PC 2016-05-09; PS4 and Xbox One 2019-02-26. Procedural galaxies linked by hyperlanes; start 2200, default 300-year campaign, highest score wins. Pops in worker, specialist, and ruler strata fill jobs from districts and buildings; eight ethics on four axes; factions produce unity; galactic crises. Fahraeus named Star Control II, Master of Orion II, and EU4 as influences.
